verdict.rationale: Buzz's relay hosts 'huddle audio' (buzz-supp-agents-md mentions relay 'also hosts git + huddle audio') and mentions 'drop into voice huddles' (buzz-gh-2), suggesting some in-app audio call capability exists, but there is no documentation of a team-admin-facing UI flow for starting an audio/video call directly from a channel or DM, no video call evidence beyond frame-anchored video comments (buzz-docs-3), and no admin-specific controls for initiating calls. missing for 10: explicit UI/UX documentation of starting audio or video calls from a channel/DM, video call support (not just audio huddles), admin-specific call controls, and independent/hands-on confirmation that this works in practice.
